name: 9h nine hours Nagoya station
detail: There are many foreign travelers, but everyone has good manners, and from young people to elderly individuals like myself, I was able to spend a night safely, securely, and cleanly without much inconvenience. It's about a 5-minute walk from the station, and there’s a FamilyMart nearby. There is also a famous ramen restaurant right around the corner. The night view from the lounge on the 18th floor of the Nagoya location is not very good due to the tall buildings blocking it, but you can have meals, work, or read in the comfort of a counter with sofas and outlets. The shower room is spacious and clean, and the provided towel set is large and fluffy, which should be sufficient even for a person with a robust physique. One slight dissatisfaction was that, even when there was a queue at check-in, there was only one young male staff member at the reception, and I think this could be improved.

name: Sanco Inn Nagoya Shinkansenguchi
detail: It was conveniently located just across from the Shinkansen exit, accessible within about a 5-minute walk. The facilities were kept clean, and the soundproofing was excellent, allowing me to sleep soundly at night. The staff were also very friendly and accommodating, making my stay enjoyable. I would like to use it again.

name: HOTEL LiVEMAX NAGOYA SHINKANSENGUCHI
detail: This time, I stayed overnight to attend a live performance at Vantelin Dome. Although it was just one night, I had a lot of luggage due to support goods, and I wanted to store my bags after arriving if possible. However, when I checked with ChatGPT, I was told, This hotel doesn't seem to offer luggage storage. Considering that this information might be outdated, I asked through Agoda the day before if it was possible to store my luggage, and despite the late hour, I received a response saying, We can store your luggage from early morning on the day of check-in. By being able to store my luggage here in the morning, my subsequent movements and activities became much easier. Thank you very much. (I was also grateful that they handled the check-in process and brought my luggage to the room.) The twin non-smoking room, while not very spacious, had a separate bath and toilet and was clean. Although I didn't use it this time, having a microwave in the room is a nice feature, isn't it? The checkout process was smooth as well, just putting the card in the box, making for a very comfortable stay. At around *** yen for one person, it offers great cost performance! In the surrounding area, there's a Seven-Eleven and a Daily Store nearby, but it's relatively quiet, which is nice. There is a delicious eel Japanese restaurant called Shirakawa nearby. KANNON Coffee, located in the building right in front, is also recommended for breakfast.

name: APA Hotel Nagoya Ekimae
detail: The accommodation is well-located, within easy walking distance to the core shopping district and convenient for shopping. The room is tidy and clean, with complete facilities. The building is situated in a quiet alley at night, ensuring good sleep quality. The staff are friendly and professional, with attentive service. Overall, it offers great value for money and is a recommended option.

name: Prince Smart Inn Nagoya Sakae
detail: This is the hotel I used for my first visit to Nagoya. First of all, it's close to Fushimi Station, making it convenient to use the Fushimi underground shopping center and travel to Nagoya Station and Sakae. There is a Family Mart right in front of the accommodation, and there are also nearby Lawson and Seven-Eleven, so it's easy to grab convenience store snacks. There are also famous ramen shops nearby, and a chain of tebasaki (chicken wings) restaurants, making it nice to wrap up a day of travel with a beer. Although Sakae's Don Quijote is in a straight line, it's still a bit of a distance, so it might feel burdensome to move after shopping there. However, the price for the stay is reasonable, including breakfast. For breakfast, they serve pork cutlet sandwiches or regular bread, which you can pack for a snack during your travels. Plus, there are ice machines, microwaves, and hot water available in the lobby, which is convenient. The bathtub in the bathroom was deeper than expected, making it great for a half-body soak. I utilized it well to unwind after a day of travel. The bedding was comfortable for resting, but the sound insulation seemed poor, as I could hear voices from the neighboring room. Still, even after check-out, they stored my luggage, and the check-in device supported Korean, which was convenient. I recommend this accommodation for its cost-effectiveness.

name: Kuretake Inn Premium Nagoya Nayabashi
detail: Within walking distance from Nagoya Station. The loop bus from the front of the station makes the Yanagibashi bus stop very convenient. There is a bathhouse within the building that can be used as many times as desired during the available hours. Breakfast is included in some plans. There are many restaurants, convenience stores, and drugstores nearby, so shopping is not a problem. Amenities and loungewear are available near the front desk, and guests can choose and take them to their rooms. There is an evening welcome drink time. The cost performance is very good.

name: Natural Hot Spring Hotel LiVEMAX PREMIUM Nagoya Marunouchi
detail: I used this for sightseeing in Nagoya on a trip with my son✨ The access from Nagoya Station was good, and it was within walking distance to the downtown area, so the location was very nice. The price was very reasonable, yet the room, lobby, and large public bath were all very clean. I was looking forward to the large bath being a natural hot spring as advertised. It was a bit small, but since there was no one there at the time, I was able to relax and enjoy it. If I ever go to Nagoya again, I will definitely want to stay here again.

name: Nagoya Tokyu Hotel
detail: I was invited to a wedding and stayed at the Tokyu Hotel near Nagoya Station since there was no accommodation at the venue. Arriving early, they kindly stored my luggage, allowing me to spend the time meaningfully until check-in. I was informed that there were no smoking rooms available, and was directed to the smoking area. The room was well-equipped with towels and amenities. The cleaning was thorough, and the room was clean. I felt that the lighting in the room was a bit dim; perhaps because it was dark, I was able to sleep well. There was a taxi stand inside the hotel, which I used to get to the venue. It was nice that there was Sekai no Yamachan behind the hotel, which I could walk to. I was able to choose my breakfast, and since I had the chance, I had it at Nadaman. It was delicious. I would appreciate it if there is another opportunity.

name: 2025 Renewal Open - Anshin Oyado Nagoya Man / Woman Sakae Station
detail: It has everything, everything you can think of and can't think of, nail clippers, contact lens cleaning solution, and even sanitary pads in the women's restroom, it really saved my life, absolutely wonderful!!! And the best part is that the luggage area and sleeping area are completely separate, so I won’t be disturbed by the sound of my roommate packing plastic bags, which is very important. I would call this the most crucial factor in whether a hostel might be noisy. It's been a year since I wrote this review, and I still haven't found anything better than this. There’s always food on the top floor, drinks are constantly available, the curry in the morning is delicious, you can cook your own noodles and make miso soup, and there are various drinks available at night, which is a delight for alcohol lovers. There are massage chairs, a large pool for soaking, comic books, and coming back every day is truly pleasant, such a great experience.

name: Hostel Wasabi Nagoya Ekimae
detail: I checked in to a capsule hotel for the first time, feeling nervous, and there were separate spaces divided into two levels from A to H on each floor. I was in E-2, but it was surprisingly spacious and didn't feel cramped at all. Each shower room had a changing area, and the washroom was clean and very nice. Above all, it was close to the station and felt safe.
